# Sirach Chapter 19 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 19 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_019_page_001.jpg

---

**19:1** A worker who is given to drinking will not grow rich; one who despises small things will fail gradually.

**19:2** Wine and women lead clever men astray, and the man who frequents prostitutes grows bolder in his recklessness.

**19:3** Decay and worms will be his inheritance, and an audacious soul will be cut off.

**19:4** One who trusts too quickly is shallow of mind, and by sinning he wrongs himself.

**19:5** One who takes pleasure in evil will be condemned, and one who hates gossip has less evil to deal with.

**19:6** Whoever repeats a matter is a tattler — do not trust such a person, and nothing you tell them will remain secret.

**19:7** Do not repeat what you hear, and you will come to no harm.

**19:8** Do not tell it to friend or enemy; and unless it is a sin for you, do not disclose it.

**19:9** For someone has heard you and observed you, and when the time comes he will despise you.

**19:10** Have you heard something? Let it die within you. Take courage — it will not burst you.

**19:11** At hearing a word a fool will be in labor — like a woman giving birth to a child.

**19:12** Like an arrow lodged in the thigh, so is a word inside a fool.

**19:13** Reprove a friend — perhaps he did not do what is said; and if he did, so that he may not do it again.

**19:14** Reprove your neighbor — perhaps he did not say what is reported; and if he did say it, so that he may not say it again.

**19:15** Reprove a friend — for often slander is involved; and do not trust everything you hear.

**19:16** There is the person who slips without meaning to sin; and who has never gone wrong with the tongue?

**19:17** Reprove your neighbor before threatening him; and leave room for the law of the Most High.

**19:18** All wisdom is the fear of the LORD, and in all wisdom is the fulfillment of the law.

**19:19** The knowledge of wickedness is not wisdom, and the counsel of sinners is not prudence.

**19:20** There is a cleverness that is detestable, and there is a person who lacks wisdom yet understands what is right.

**19:21** There is one who is slow of understanding but fears God; and there is one who is very shrewd but breaks the law.

**19:22** There is a cunning cleverness that is wicked, and there is one who twists justice to secure a verdict.

**19:23** There is a villain who walks about bowed in grief, while all the while his inward self is full of deceit.

**19:24** He averts his face and pretends not to hear; but when no one is looking, he will take advantage of you.

**19:25** And even if lack of strength keeps him from sinning, when he finds an opportunity he will do harm.

**19:26** A person is known by his appearance, and an intelligent person is recognized at first sight.

**19:27** A man's clothing, his hearty laughter, and his manner of walking reveal his character.

**19:28** There is one who rebukes with false charges, and there is one who judges unjustly; and there is one who acts wickedly but acquits the innocent.

**19:29** There is one who transgresses while feigning deep humility, all the while filled with deceit inside.

**19:30** There is one who bows very low in seeming humility, though his heart is full of treachery.
